name: Double Dire
body:
Prerequisite(s): Second bane weapon class feature, Two-Weapon Fighting

Benefit(s): If wielding two bane weapons in combat and both threaten criticals in one round, each strike receives a +1 circumstance bonus to the threat confirmation roll.
